text:
The plate holds a teriyaki-style meat and rice dish. I estimate the portion at about 300 g: roughly 150 g of rice and 120 g of meat, plus sauce. At around 1.5 kcal/g, that comes to about 450 kcal.

The second photo shows an almost empty plate with only a little residue left. I estimate about 95% was eaten, so about 285 g and 430 kcal.

The glass of water has no calories, so it does not change the total.

{"kcal": 430, "mass_g": 285}
